// Source extraction only. No Loki imports, execution, hashing or builder simulation.
// Usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki > label-builder.json
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

type obj map[string]any
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}
type env map[string]obj

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func hash(b []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(b)) }
func load(root, path, want string) *source {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
	must(err)
	if hash(b) != want {
		panic("source differs from pinned revision: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, b, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return &source{path, b, fs, f}
}
func (s *source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s *source) record(n ast.Node) obj {
	a, b := s.fs.Position(n.Pos()), s.fs.Position(n.End())
	return obj{"source": s.path, "original_go": s.code(n), "source_range": obj{
		"start_line": a.Line, "start_column": a.Column, "end_line": b.Line, "end_column": b.Column,
		"start_byte": a.Offset, "end_byte_exclusive": b.Offset}}
}
func (s *source) selection(f *ast.FuncDecl) obj {
	r := s.record(f)
	end := s.fs.Position(f.End()).Offset
	if end >= len(s.data) || s.data[end] != '\n' {
		panic("selection missing trailing newline")
	}
	r["original_go"] = s.code(f) + "\n"
	r["sha256"] = hash([]byte(s.code(f) + "\n"))
	r["name"] = f.Name.Name
	if f.Doc != nil {
		r["documentation"] = s.record(f.Doc)
	}
	return r
}
func clone(e env) env {
	out := env{}
	for k, v := range e {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
}
func str(e ast.Expr) string {
	l, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	if !ok || l.Kind != token.STRING {
		panic("expected original string literal")
	}
	v, err := strconv.Unquote(l.Value)
	must(err)
	return v
}
func normalized(kind string, value any) obj { return obj{"kind": kind, "value": value} }
func stringValue(v obj) string {
	if v["kind"] != "string" {
		panic("not an immutable original string")
	}
	return v["value"].(string)
}

var aliases = map[string]string{"logqlmodel.ErrorLabel": "__error__", "logqlmodel.ErrorDetailsLabel": "__error_details__"}
var categories = map[string]bool{"StreamLabel": true, "StructuredMetadataLabel": true, "ParsedLabel": true}
var callNames = map[string]bool{}
var assertionIDs = map[token.Pos]obj{}

func init() {
	// A closed vocabulary: unknown expressions and calls fail even if the full-file
	// source guard is intentionally bypassed by a disposable validation harness.
	for _, n := range strings.Fields(`labels.FromStrings labels.EmptyLabels labels.StableHash labels.New labels.NewBuilder labels.Equal
	NewBaseLabelsBuilder NewBaseLabelsBuilderWithGrouping newHasher newBuilder buildErrored
	assertLabelResult sortLabelSlice mergeLabels collidingLabelPair append make errors.New fmt.Sprintf strings.Repeat
	require.Equal require.True require.False require.ElementsMatch require.NotEqual assert.Equal
	b.Reset b.Set b.Add b.Del b.SetErr b.SetErrorDetails b.GetWithCategory b.BaseHas b.LabelsResult b.GroupedLabels b.IntoMap b.UnsortedLabels b.GetErr b.GetErrorDetails b.HasErrorDetails
	bb.ForLabels bb.Hash h.HashSorted t.Helper t.Run
	lbsWithErr.Labels lbsWithErr.String lbsWithErr.Hash lbsWithErr.Stream lbsWithErr.StructuredMetadata lbsWithErr.Parsed
	expectedLbs.String actual.Stream actual.StructuredMetadata actual.Parsed
	a.String b.String ra.Stream rb.Stream`) {
		callNames[n] = true
	}
}
func allowedCall(s *source, c *ast.CallExpr) bool {
	name := s.code(c.Fun)
	if callNames[name] {
		return true
	}
	// Only the explicitly selected nested API methods, never arbitrary calls.
	if sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok {
		if _, nested := sel.X.(*ast.CallExpr); nested {
			switch sel.Sel.Name {
			case "ForLabels", "Labels", "Get", "Has":
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
func expr(s *source, x ast.Expr, e env) obj {
	r := s.record(x)
	var v obj
	switch n := x.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		switch n.Kind {
		case token.STRING:
			text := str(n)
			v = normalized("string", text)
			v["bytes_base64"] = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(text))
		case token.INT:
			i, err := strconv.ParseInt(n.Value, 10, 64)
			must(err)
			v = normalized("integer", i)
		default:
			panic("unknown literal: " + s.code(n))
		}
	case *ast.Ident:
		switch n.Name {
		case "true", "false":
			v = normalized("boolean", n.Name == "true")
		case "nil":
			v = normalized("nil", nil)
		default:
			if categories[n.Name] {
				v = normalized("category", n.Name)
			} else if val, ok := e[n.Name]; ok {
				v = obj{"kind": "reference", "name": n.Name, "resolved": val,
					"resolution": "source_assignment_snapshot_not_runtime_evaluation"}
			} else {
				if n.Name != "t" && n.Name != "Name" && n.Name != "Value" {
					panic("unknown unbound identifier: " + n.Name)
				}
				v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_identifier", "name": n.Name}
			}
		}
	case *ast.SelectorExpr:
		if text, ok := aliases[s.code(n)]; ok {
			v = normalized("string", text)
			v["bytes_base64"] = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(text))
		} else {
			if s.code(n) != "b.referencedStructuredMetadata" && n.Sel.Name != "currentResult" {
				panic("unknown selector: " + s.code(n))
			}
			v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_selector", "expression": s.code(n)}
			if call, ok := n.X.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
				v["receiver"] = expr(s, call, e)
			}
		}
	case *ast.CompositeLit:
		items := []obj{}
		for _, el := range n.Elts {
			items = append(items, expr(s, el, e))
		}
		typ := ""
		if n.Type != nil {
			typ = s.code(n.Type)
		}
		v = obj{"kind": "composite", "type": typ, "items": items}
		if typ == "[]string" {
			values := []string{}
			for _, it := range items {
				values = append(values, stringValue(resolve(it)))
			}
			v = normalized("strings", values)
		}
		if typ == "map[string]string" {
			values := map[string]string{}
			for _, it := range items {
				if it["kind"] != "key_value" {
					panic("unknown map expectation")
				}
				values[stringValue(resolve(it["key"].(obj)))] = stringValue(resolve(it["value"].(obj)))
			}
			v = obj{"kind": "string_map", "value": values, "items": items}
		}
		switch typ {
		case "", "[]string", "[]labels.Label", "map[string]string", "map[string][]labels.Label", "[]LabelCategory":
		default:
			panic("unknown composite literal: " + typ)
		}
		if typ == "[]labels.Label" || typ == "" {
			if pairs, ok := labelStructs(items); ok {
				v = obj{"kind": "labels", "labels": pairs}
			}
		}
	case *ast.KeyValueExpr:
		v = obj{"kind": "key_value", "key": expr(s, n.Key, e), "value": expr(s, n.Value, e)}
	case *ast.ArrayType:
		v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_type", "expression": s.code(n)}
	case *ast.MapType:
		v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_type", "expression": s.code(n)}
	case *ast.IndexExpr:
		v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_index", "base": expr(s, n.X, e), "index": expr(s, n.Index, e)}
	case *ast.BinaryExpr:
		if n.Op != token.EQL && n.Op != token.NEQ {
			panic("unknown binary expression")
		}
		v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_comparison", "operator": n.Op.String(), "left": expr(s, n.X, e), "right": expr(s, n.Y, e)}
	case *ast.FuncLit:
		v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_local_function", "body": s.record(n.Body)}
	case *ast.CallExpr:
		if !allowedCall(s, n) {
			panic("unknown call: " + s.code(n.Fun))
		}
		name := s.code(n.Fun)
		args := []obj{}
		for _, a := range n.Args {
			args = append(args, expr(s, a, e))
		}
		v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_call", "call": name, "arguments": args, "ellipsis": n.Ellipsis.IsValid()}
		if sel, ok := n.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok {
			if nested, ok := sel.X.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
				v["receiver"] = expr(s, nested, e)
			}
		}
		switch name {
		case "labels.FromStrings":
			texts := []string{}
			if n.Ellipsis.IsValid() {
				if len(args) != 1 || resolve(args[0])["kind"] != "strings" {
					panic("nonliteral FromStrings expansion")
				}
				texts = resolve(args[0])["value"].([]string)
			} else {
				for _, a := range args {
					texts = append(texts, stringValue(resolve(a)))
				}
			}
			if len(texts)%2 != 0 {
				panic("odd label literals")
			}
			pairs := []obj{}
			for i := 0; i < len(texts); i += 2 {
				pairs = append(pairs, obj{"name": texts[i], "value": texts[i+1]})
			}
			v["kind"], v["labels"] = "labels", pairs
		case "labels.EmptyLabels":
			v["kind"], v["labels"] = "labels", []obj{}
		case "append":
			if len(args) == 0 || resolve(args[0])["kind"] != "strings" {
				panic("unknown append")
			}
			texts := append([]string{}, resolve(args[0])["value"].([]string)...)
			for _, a := range args[1:] {
				texts = append(texts, stringValue(resolve(a)))
			}
			v["kind"], v["value"] = "strings", texts
		case "NewBaseLabelsBuilderWithGrouping":
			if len(args) != 4 {
				panic("group constructor arity")
			}
			v["parameters"] = obj{"groups": args[0], "parser_key_hints": args[1], "without": args[2], "no_labels": args[3]}
		case "buildErrored":
			if len(args) != 3 {
				panic("local helper arity")
			}
			v["parameters"] = obj{"category": args[0], "groups": args[1], "without": args[2]}
		case "mergeLabels":
			v["label_components"] = args // Not merged, sorted, deduplicated or rendered.
		case "b.Set":
			if len(args) != 3 {
				panic("Set arity")
			}
			v["parameters"] = obj{"category": args[0], "name": args[1], "value": args[2]}
		case "b.Add":
			if len(args) != 2 {
				panic("Add arity")
			}
			v["parameters"] = obj{"category": args[0], "labels": args[1]}
		case "b.Del":
			v["parameters"] = obj{"names": args}
		case "b.SetErr":
			if len(args) != 2 {
				panic("SetErr arity")
			}
			v["parameters"] = obj{"error": args[0], "details_error_expression": args[1]}
		case "b.SetErrorDetails":
			if len(args) != 1 {
				panic("SetErrorDetails arity")
			}
			v["parameters"] = obj{"details": args[0]}
		}
	default:
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("unknown expression %T: %s", x, s.code(x)))
	}
	for k, val := range v {
		r[k] = val
	}
	return r
}
func resolve(v obj) obj {
	for v["kind"] == "reference" {
		v = v["resolved"].(obj)
	}
	return v
}
func labelStructs(items []obj) ([]obj, bool) {
	pairs := []obj{}
	for _, item := range items {
		if item["kind"] != "composite" {
			return nil, false
		}
		fields := item["items"].([]obj)
		p := obj{}
		for _, f := range fields {
			if f["kind"] != "key_value" {
				return nil, false
			}
			k := f["key"].(obj)["name"]
			if k != "Name" && k != "Value" {
				return nil, false
			}
			p[strings.ToLower(k.(string))] = stringValue(resolve(f["value"].(obj)))
		}
		if len(p) != 2 {
			return nil, false
		}
		pairs = append(pairs, p)
	}
	return pairs, true
}
func assertion(s *source, c *ast.CallExpr, e env) obj {
	r := s.record(c)
	name := s.code(c.Fun)
	if !callNames[name] {
		panic("unknown assertion: " + name)
	}
	r["assertion"] = name
	id, ok := assertionIDs[c.Pos()]
	if !ok {
		panic("unindexed source assertion")
	}
	for k, v := range id {
		r[k] = v
	}
	args := []obj{}
	for _, a := range c.Args {
		args = append(args, expr(s, a, e))
	}
	r["arguments"] = args
	if name == "assertLabelResult" {
		r["expected"], r["actual"] = args[1], args[2]
		r["channels"] = []string{"labels", "symbolic_stable_hash", "symbolic_string"}
	} else if strings.HasSuffix(name, ".Equal") || strings.HasSuffix(name, ".NotEqual") || strings.HasSuffix(name, ".ElementsMatch") {
		r["expected"], r["actual"] = args[1], args[2]
	} else if strings.HasSuffix(name, ".True") || strings.HasSuffix(name, ".False") {
		r["expected"] = normalized("boolean", strings.HasSuffix(name, ".True"))
		r["actual"] = args[1]
	}
	if expected, ok := r["expected"].(obj); ok {
		r["expected_resolved"] = resolve(expected)
	}
	return r
}
func isAssertion(name string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(name, "require.") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "assert.") || name == "assertLabelResult"
}
func inventory(s *source, f *ast.FuncDecl) []obj {
	out := []obj{}
	ast.Inspect(f.Body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok && isAssertion(s.code(c.Fun)) {
			id := obj{"source_function": f.Name.Name, "source_assertion_index": len(out)}
			assertionIDs[c.Pos()] = id
			r := s.record(c)
			r["assertion"] = s.code(c.Fun)
			for k, v := range id {
				r[k] = v
			}
			out = append(out, r)
		}
		return true
	})
	return out
}
func stream(s *source, b *ast.BlockStmt, e env, path string) []obj {
	out := []obj{}
	for _, st := range b.List {
		r := s.record(st)
		r["identity"] = fmt.Sprintf("%s/line:%d", path, s.fs.Position(st.Pos()).Line)
		switch n := st.(type) {
		case *ast.AssignStmt:
			r["kind"] = "assignment"
			r["operator"] = n.Tok.String()
			values := []obj{}
			for _, x := range n.Rhs {
				values = append(values, expr(s, x, e))
			}
			r["values"] = values
			targets := []string{}
			for i, x := range n.Lhs {
				targets = append(targets, s.code(x))
				v := values[0]
				if len(n.Lhs) == len(values) {
					v = values[i]
				} else {
					v = obj{"kind": "symbolic_tuple_binding", "binding_index": i, "expression": v}
				}
				if id, ok := x.(*ast.Ident); ok && id.Name != "_" {
					e[id.Name] = v
				}
				// Literal map membership is source data, not builder state. Preserve
				// the sixth hash input's geometry symbolically instead of generating it.
				if idx, ok := x.(*ast.IndexExpr); ok {
					if id, ok := idx.X.(*ast.Ident); ok && id.Name == "cases" {
						old := resolve(e[id.Name])
						items := append([]obj{}, old["items"].([]obj)...)
						items = append(items, obj{"kind": "key_value", "key": expr(s, idx.Index, e), "value": v})
						copy := obj{}
						for k, x := range old {
							copy[k] = x
						}
						copy["items"] = items
						e[id.Name] = copy
					}
				}
			}
			r["targets"] = targets
		case *ast.DeclStmt:
			r["kind"] = "declaration"
			g, ok := n.Decl.(*ast.GenDecl)
			if !ok || g.Tok != token.CONST {
				panic("unknown local declaration")
			}
			for _, sp := range g.Specs {
				v := sp.(*ast.ValueSpec)
				if len(v.Names) != 1 || len(v.Values) != 1 {
					panic("unknown const")
				}
				e[v.Names[0].Name] = expr(s, v.Values[0], e)
				r["value"] = e[v.Names[0].Name]
			}
		case *ast.ExprStmt:
			c, ok := n.X.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if !ok {
				panic("unknown expression statement")
			}
			name := s.code(c.Fun)
			if name == "t.Run" {
				r["kind"] = "subtest"
				r["name"] = expr(s, c.Args[0], e)
				fn, ok := c.Args[1].(*ast.FuncLit)
				if !ok {
					panic("unknown subtest body")
				}
				r["events"] = stream(s, fn.Body, clone(e), path+"/subtest:"+stringValue(resolve(expr(s, c.Args[0], e))))
			} else if isAssertion(name) {
				r["kind"] = "assertion"
				r["assertion"] = assertion(s, c, e)
			} else {
				r["kind"] = "operation"
				r["call"] = expr(s, c, e)
				if sel, ok := c.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok {
					r["operation"] = sel.Sel.Name
					r["receiver"] = s.code(sel.X)
				}
			}
		case *ast.RangeStmt:
			r["kind"] = "loop"
			r["range"] = expr(s, n.X, e)
			r["body"] = s.record(n.Body)
			v := resolve(expr(s, n.X, e))
			iterations := []obj{}
			if v["kind"] == "composite" {
				for i, item := range v["items"].([]obj) {
					local := clone(e)
					identity := strconv.Itoa(i)
					if item["kind"] == "key_value" {
						key, val := item["key"].(obj), item["value"].(obj)
						identity = stringValue(resolve(key))
						if n.Key != nil {
							local[s.code(n.Key)] = key
						}
						if n.Value != nil {
							local[s.code(n.Value)] = val
						}
					} else {
						if n.Value != nil {
							local[s.code(n.Value)] = item
						}
						identity = resolve(item)["value"].(string)
					}
					iterations = append(iterations, obj{"source_index": i, "name": identity, "events": stream(s, n.Body, local, path+"/iteration:"+identity)})
				}
				r["iterations"] = iterations
				r["expansion"] = "original_literal_members_not_runtime_map_order"
			} else {
				r["expansion"] = "symbolic_geometry_not_executed"
			}
		default:
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("unknown statement %T", st))
		}
		out = append(out, r)
	}
	return out
}
func countEvents(events []obj, counts map[string]int) {
	for _, r := range events {
		k := r["kind"].(string)
		counts[k]++
		if k == "assertion" {
			name := r["assertion"].(obj)["assertion"].(string)
			counts["assertion:"+name]++
		}
		if child, ok := r["events"].([]obj); ok {
			countEvents(child, counts)
		}
		if it, ok := r["iterations"].([]obj); ok {
			for _, i := range it {
				counts["expanded_iteration"]++
				countEvents(i["events"].([]obj), counts)
			}
		}
	}
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	s := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logql/log/labels_test.go", "5a3383cd2799117f8f96d1e39f5af42d92f2e07a7e205086bff4d4acaa77eff9")
	prod := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logql/log/labels.go", "2f37f986442f5535402d0bd1503135fb358027e006842eba5e5690c64880e0f8")
	errs := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logqlmodel/error.go", "21816c4294243f16157f6408d92fb0907612a3258333288ab39b3f84bf7a4db5")
	selections := []obj{}
	helpers := []obj{}
	excluded := []obj{}
	assertions := 0
	counts := map[string]int{}
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		name := f.Name.Name
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "Test") {
			r := s.selection(f)
			r["source_function_index"] = len(selections)
			inv := inventory(s, f)
			r["assertion_calls"] = inv
			r["assertion_call_site_count"] = len(inv)
			assertions += len(inv)
			events := stream(s, f.Body, env{}, name)
			r["events"] = events
			countEvents(events, counts)
			selections = append(selections, r)
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(name, "Benchmark") {
			r := s.record(f)
			delete(r, "original_go")
			r["name"] = name
			r["reason"] = "benchmark_explicitly_excluded"
			excluded = append(excluded, r)
		} else {
			switch name {
			case "sortLabelSlice", "assertLabelResult", "mergeLabels", "collidingLabelPair":
			default:
				panic("unknown helper: " + name)
			}
			r := s.selection(f)
			r["assertion_calls"] = inventory(s, f)
			if name == "collidingLabelPair" {
				bindings := []obj{}
				for _, st := range f.Body.List {
					if a, ok := st.(*ast.AssignStmt); ok {
						if c, ok := a.Rhs[0].(*ast.CallExpr); ok && s.code(c.Fun) == "labels.FromStrings" {
							bindings = append(bindings, obj{"name": s.code(a.Lhs[0]), "labels_expression": expr(s, c, env{})})
						}
					}
				}
				r["literal_label_bindings"] = bindings
			}
			helpers = append(helpers, r)
		}
	}
	if len(selections) != 15 || len(helpers) != 4 || len(excluded) != 3 {
		panic("source inventory mismatch")
	}
	support := []obj{}
	for _, d := range prod.file.Decls {
		if g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
			for _, sp := range g.Specs {
				if v, ok := sp.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok && len(v.Names) > 0 && v.Names[0].Name == "StreamLabel" {
					r := prod.record(g)
					r["sha256"] = hash([]byte(prod.code(g)))
					support = append(support, r)
				}
			}
		}
		if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok {
			switch f.Name.Name {
			case "NewBaseLabelsBuilderWithGrouping", "NewBaseLabelsBuilder", "SetErr", "SetErrorDetails", "Set", "Add", "Del", "Reset", "ForLabels", "GetWithCategory", "BaseHas":
				support = append(support, prod.selection(f))
			}
		}
	}
	for _, d := range errs.file.Decls {
		if g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok {
			for _, sp := range g.Specs {
				if v, ok := sp.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok && len(v.Names) == 1 {
					name := v.Names[0].Name
					if want, ok := aliases["logqlmodel."+name]; ok {
						if str(v.Values[0]) != want {
							panic("alias drift")
						}
						r := errs.record(v)
						r["sha256"] = hash([]byte(errs.code(v)))
						support = append(support, r)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sources := []obj{}
	for _, src := range []*source{s, prod, errs} {
		sources = append(sources, obj{"path": src.path, "sha256": hash(src.data)})
	}
	out := obj{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "contract": "immutable_source_extraction_not_builder_execution", "sources": sources, "function_count": 15, "helper_count": 4, "literal_table_count": 1, "hash_input_count": 6, "hash_literal_input_count": 5, "hash_symbolic_input_count": 1, "preserve_error_expanded_identity_count": 9, "assertion_call_site_count": assertions, "expanded_event_counts": counts, "tables": selections, "supporting_helpers": helpers, "supporting_declarations": support, "excluded_benchmarks": excluded}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(enc.Encode(out))
}
